title: Introduce onboarding 'Stability Catalyst' sampler and release signet artifact
author: Ananya Mukherjee
release_notes:
- Add Stability Catalyst: lightweight stratified canary sampler for onboarding.
- Add Release Signet: compact release artifact with performance stamps, sample coverage, and provenance hash.
- Automatic delta changelog draft generation based on sampled probes.
- Non-breaking metadata version bump and compatibility adapters.
body:
Context and motivation: We continue to see missed regressions after full ingestion because large profile snapshots are expensive to run on every onboard. This PR adds a lightweight, deterministic canary sampler ("Stability Catalyst") that runs a small, stratified probe against incoming model artifacts to surface regressions early and cheaply. It also introduces a compact Release Signet artifact (signet v2) that bundles a model fingerprint, a small set of sampled performance stamps, coverage metadata, and a provenance hash suitable for shipping with onboarding bundles and using as changelog seeds. The goal is faster feedback during reviewer cycles, better changelog diffs for releases, and a low-cost signal that can be used by the console and release automation.

What this PR does (single-line checklist): [x] Add Stability Catalyst sampler implementation and config, [x] Add Release Signet v2 schema + writer, [x] Wireup canary integration to onboarding pipeline and CLI, [x] Add auto-draft delta changelog generator that consumes Signet diffs, [x] Add telemetry metrics and basic dashboard queries, [x] Add unit + integration tests, [x] Update onboarding docs and quickstart.

Design notes: Stability Catalyst uses stratified sampling across prompt archetypes (short/long, chat/prompt, high/low entropy) with deterministic seeding so runs are repeatable. Each probe produces a minimal perf stamp: median latency at configured p95 concurrency, token-cost estimate, and a quality fingerprint (checksum of evaluation answers using approximate normalization). The Signet v2 schema is intentionally compact: header(metadata), fingerprint, array<perf_stamp>, sample_coverage_map, provenance_hash, and a signed manifest when KMS is available. Metadata version bump is isolated to the metadata_adapter layer; adapters provide backwards compatibility to signet v1 consumers. The changelog drafter compares two signets and produces a concise delta (human-readable blurb + structured tags) optimized for automated release notes.

Commits summary: feat(onboard): add stability catalyst sampler; feat(signet): introduce signet v2 protobuf + writer; feat(cli): onboard --probe flag & signet export; feat(changelog): add signet-based delta drafter + unit tests; perf(test): integration test harness for canary runs; docs: onboarding guides and quickstart snippets; ci: add signet generation job to pipeline.

Changed areas (high-level): sampler implementation and configuration under pkg/onboard/sampler; signet schema and writer under pkg/onboard/signet; CLI hook in cmd/onboard; small onboarding pipeline change to run the sampler pre-curation; changelog automation under webhooks/autogen; new telemetry counters and a PromQL example in internal/telemetry.

Testing and CI: Added unit tests that validate deterministic sampling, signet serialization, and delta drafts. Integration test spins up a lightweight emulated onboard flow (test/integration/onboard_canary_test.go) which runs a canary sample against a pinned model tarball. CI pipeline has a new job generate-signet that runs in matrix with linux/go1.20 and python3.11 for the changelog drafter. Flaky test note: initial run produced a timing-sensitive flake under race detector; added a small jitter tolerance (50ms) to the integration harness which stabilized the job. Final CI status for this PR: all checks passed after two reruns.

Review conversation (high-level): Reviewer Liam: requested clearer separation between the Signet schema and future extensibility points; asked for adapters so old consumers don't break. Author: added metadata_adapter.go and explicit migration path in the docs. Reviewer Priya: asked about security of provenance_hash and signing; Author: added KMS integration optional flow and signing tests; documented the signing contract. Reviewer Owen: suggested more visible metrics; Author: added p95/p99 histograms and a sampler success/failure gauge to metrics_registry.go. After addressal, Priya approved with minor comments; Liam approved; Owen gave final LGTM.

Backward compatibility and migration: This is non-breaking for existing consumers — signet v2 is produced only when onboard flag --emit-signet=v2 is present and metadata_adapter can downgrade to v1 when necessary. We added a deprecation policy note in docs stating that v1 will be supported for 9 months post-merge. The metadata version in manifests is bumped (metadata.v=3) and the adapter layer maps v2->v1 on request.

Operational notes: Onboarding controllers should set a reasonable default sampler budget (default: 5 probes per onboard) to limit cost. Console will display Signet summary cards (perf stamps + coverage) once the console PR lands (follow-up). Changelog drafts are written to a draft bucket and surfaced to the release automation via a webhook.

Security and compliance: Signet provenance_hash is HMAC-SHA256 over the serialized header+fingerprint using project-level key. Signing with KMS wraps HMAC with a timestamped attest. No sensitive customer data is stored in signet; sampling inputs are deterministic prompt archetypes derived from public test suites or customer-provided promptsets (consent required).

Follow-ups and future work: - Console UI to render signet cards and inline diffs (follow-up PR). - Expand sampler archetypes with model-specific affordances (follow-up research spike). - Integrate signet generation into scheduled nightly baseline generation.

Merge outcome: Squash and merge. Merged by Ananya Mukherjee after final approvals and green CI.

Related work: touches onboarding lint rules (see pkg/onboard/lint) and plays nicely with the existing profile fingerprints work (ENG-4032).

Notes for release: Include the Signet v2 schema note in the model registry changelog and mark the metadata.v change in the release blurb.
